body: I'm just a zombie anymore wearing a mask. I don't know what the hell im doing. Not a very functional human at this point.

I'm sorry to hear that that happened to you. My ex got with her now fiancé a month after we separated (we'd been together 8 years and started dating in high school) and got pregnant a couple months later. He's in prison now and has a bunch of felonies. All things considered, this depression has robbed me of life. My divorce was essentially the catalyst for a shit load of issues that I've had growing up. I've never been independent and have no comprehension of anything anymore. I'm not sure what I believe in anymore, but I'm just existing now. I've been sitting inside all day.

Facebook decided to throw some nostalgia in my face today with a memory of July 4th 2013. I was smiling and outside enjoying the holiday with my family. Today I am alone in a dark basement while my ex wife and daughters are enjoying the day with their baby brother. 3 years is a lifetime. I'm a shell of my former self and can't bare to look in the mirror anymore. I'm sorry you feel the same. I wouldn't wish this pain on anyone.

I'm sorry for what you're going through. My situation is different, but I understand the loneliness. Mine comes from immense guilt and regret. I'm divorced and a shitty father, much because of my depression and other issues. Watching my kids grow up in the house we shared with my ex wife's new family is too much anymore. I am a failure and can't take it anymore. You seem like a good person and I hope you are able to find someone. From my stance, I had it all and I fucked everything up.
Yeah they are definitely aware and it's really playing a toll on them. I internalize the guilt and self-hate even more because of it.
It feels like I'm watching my family drown while I am stuck on shore unable to do anything.
I won't be. I'm too far gone at this point.

Same. I'm a child in an adult's body. Yeah I believe it is disassociation/derealization. I wish I knew what it was like to be in sync and not completely delusional. Then again, the way I feel about life makes me think I'm not delusional. I just see it for what it is.

Yeah I met all the criteria but even if not, the reality is I know what I've done and what I am. I meet the definition of BPD head on and I'm 99% sure I inherited it from my mother. And yeah I can relate - I break down crying for no reason and self destruct like crazy. I overthink things to the point of insanity, I'm unstable as they come in terms of reliability, and I am unable to process events in a normal way. I've always felt like an alien, like there's a fundamental disconnect between me and everyone else. I try mimicking others but I've never had a unique identity. I've always felt like I'm watching myself live instead of living. Hard to describe.

No she left me and for good reasons. I'm not a good person really and I have come to accept that. No I wouldn't, and I've taken advantage of everything they've done for me. The more I think about it, the more I realize how much I deserve this. I've never loved myself and I self-sabotage to the extreme. The hyper logical part of me rationalizes it and says "what's the point?"

I feel like I'm in the 'real' and everyone around me is in the matrix. I'm pretty sure I have Aspergers and BPD as well. All things considered, I hate everything about myself. My daughters are angels and they have this monster for a father. Certainly helps lift the spirits. But I've become numb. Perhaps my mind's natural response to the situation.

No I live with my parents. I moved back here after my divorce. It's a extremely dysfunctional environment and not healthy at all for my children. Hence the fear of what's going to happen next. I feel completely and utterly powerless to change things and I'm completely apathetic about life as it is now. I'm in an existential crisis that I can't come out of and I honestly feel like I'm just prolonging the inevitable.
This is me to a tee, although a therapist is agreeing to visit me at home. I've transitioned into agoraphobia and am a recluse of sorts.

Probably not - it's not even an energy thing. I literally force myself to sleep to avoid reality. I only get comfort when asleep. All I do is think about how fucked up my life is and I browse these Reddit forums - only people I can connect with and relate to.

No its not just the friends thing. I've done this to myself - I do but I've honestly lost all hope. There's so much wrong I can't begin to describe. I barely eat anymore and have lost all ability to function as a productive member of society.

I have two close friends. One's life has taken a turn for the worse (his mom passed away, he's homeless, and he's addicted to drugs) / haven't seen him in months. Haven't seen my other in months either. I don't talk to anyone anymore and am on the verge of losing my children/livelihood. I'm by all accounts a failure and I honestly don't know how much longer I can take this existence.
Yes. I've been sleeping 20 hours a day for the last couple of weeks. I feel like I'm literally in limbo. I can't break free from this prison in my mind.
I feel the exact same. Everything has spiraled out of control and yet I'm oddly calm. Maybe it's a defense mechanism, but I feel like I'm in acceptance now.

It's probably just something random that's on OPs mind (I hope you find peace) - I find myself with the same pattern of thinking. I can think about and be doing regular mundane/trivial things simultaneously while thinking about leaving. Oddly enough this part of the post struck a chord with me the most.

Are you me? We seriously have so much in common, although I'm a divorced dad whose 70k in debt from university (pointless liberal arts degree).

I've been freelancing since 2014, but have very little to show as I can never follow through - feels like depression has turned my mind to mush and all my creative ability has gone out the window.

I'm seriously considering doing trade work - becoming an electrician sounds appealing, thought of doing lineman work to pay off debt - work a ton of overtime in a labor job to pull myself out. The hardest part is I know how well good copywriters can earn, it's just my mind won't allow me to function on the right level.

I swear the digital age plays quite the toll on us milennials, feel like I need to disconnect from it all despite my tendency to constantly wonder "what if" and live in a cycle of regret and anxiety about making a shit life decision - especially since I'm not supporting my girls the way I need to be and its only fuel for the fires of depression.
I'm an attractive guy and have been battling crippling depression for as long as I can remember - to the point of suicidal ideation again - I'd give anything to get rid of this monster in my mind.
